'''Flea''' is a small {{type|Bug}} [[enemy]] found in {{ch|The Alley}}, {{ch|The Boneyard}} and {{ch|The Desert}}, and can be spawned through multiple ability and item effects.

== Behavior ==
* On their turn, Fleas will attempt to move within melee range of a target and attack it, dealing 4 damage to both them '''and itself''', regardless of the Flea's actual {{Stat|STR}}. This self-damage typically kills the Flea.
=== Tips ===
* Fleas usually end up dying to their own attack. Be wary of Champion Fleas, however, as they can survive the self-damage from their attack.
* The self-damage a Flea takes does not change with damage-boosters (such as {{st|Strength Up}} or {{st|Damage Up}}).

== Trivia ==
*Fleas are among a small set of enemies that can be spawned as [[familiars]] directly.
* Fleas spawned from Cat Abilities will be green.
* Weirdly enough, the flea looks more like a {{Wikipedia|Antlion}} larve than a {{Wikipedia|Flea}}.
